departments.name: Computer Science & Engineering
departments.description: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) was established in 1998 with the capacity of 60 students per session with a vision to produce skilled computer professionals for the betterment of the world and to nourish the technology. Currently, the number of undergraduate student intake is 130 per academic session (two sections of 65 students each).

faculty.name: Dr. A. H. M. Ashfak Habib

departments.name: Electrical and Electronic Engineering
departments.description: Technology has been advancing very fast in the last few decades. Scientists and professionals are concentrating more on automation and communication, which in turn increase the demand for engineers all over the world. So, it is obvious that students have their dreams to be professional in this wonderful sector. We here in EEE department of CUET are wholehearted for these students who would like to see their dreams come to reality.

departments.name: Mechanical Engineering
departments.description: The Department of Mechanical Engineering is established to strive for excellence through the creation, preservation, transfer, and application of knowledge to her graduates. The engineering education in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, CUET is respected and valued for its research and education quality at both the national and international level.

faculty.name: Prof. Dr. Sheikh Muhammad Humayun Kabir

departments.name: Civil Engineering
departments.description: The Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) is committed to excellence in undergraduate and postgraduate education and research across a broad spectrum of civil engineering disciplines. The department also emphasizes multidisciplinary areas related to the planning, design, and management of infrastructure and the built environment.

departments.name: Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering
departments.description: Today, we are at the peak of the information technology age, and communication engineering plays a vital role in today's rapidly changing world. In this prospect, CUET has launched Department of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering (ETE) in the year 2012. The vision of this department is to make great contribution by producing efficient and resourceful engineers with research and development capabilities.

departments.name: Biomedical Engineering
departments.description: There is an endless demand in modern healthcare for technologies to improve the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of health problems. To meet this demand, the Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) has a strong focus on health in its research and education programs and has a department devoted entirely to this socially vital area: Biomedical Engineering.

departments.name: Materials and Metallurgical Engineering
departments.description: The Department of Materials and Metallurgical Engineering (MME) at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) was established in the 2019-2020 academic session with the goal of fostering excellence in the fields of materials science and metallurgy. Beginning its journey with just 30 undergraduate students, the department has continued to evolve and expand, maintaining a strong commitment to producing skilled engineers who are equipped with both theoretical knowledge and practical expertise.
departments.address: Academic Building 4 (Level 4), CUET, Pahartoli, Raozan, Chattogram- 4349

departments.name: Mechatronics & Industrial Engineering
departments.description: The use of Mechatronics system and industrial product automation is inevitable to enhance the productivity and the growth of national economy. And, it is a matter of time that all industries are going to be replaced by automated technology to achieve the vision of knowledge based industry in Bangladesh. Therefore, to meet the technological challenges, study and research in the field of mechatronics and its application to industrial processes has become important issue in Bangladesh.

departments.name: Petroleum And Mining Engineering
departments.description: The Department of Petroleum and Mining Engineering (PME) offers Bachelor of Science in Petroleum and Mining engineering which is one the top university level programs among the engineering universities in Bangladesh. This discipline is founded in March, 2010. 30 students are enrolled in this discipline every year. The department has a good number of quality faculties and has very well organized and enriched lab facilities.

departments.name: Water Resources Engineering
departments.description: Population growth and economic development continue to place increasing stress on global water resources, stresses that stem primarily from rising consumptive demands for limited supplies and increasing contaminant loads to natural waters. This growing population and need for clean water at everywhere demands specific professional on Water Resources Engineers to develop solutions that are environmentally sustainable, economically viable and socially acceptable.

faculty.name: Pollen Chakma
faculty.office: Room No: 1335, 2nd Floor, Civil Engineering Building, CUET

departments.name: Architecture
departments.description: Department of Architecture has marked a progression in the history of Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology which has been established in 2009 under the Faculty of Architecture & Planning. The Department of Architecture has been established alongside the existing engineering education. The Department of Architecture is committed to advance architectural education through different programs and researches. The department continuously endeavors to instill in the students a firm intellectual and professional base.

departments.name: Urban and Regional Planning
departments.description: As the geographical location of the institution is in a hilly region, the scope of planning and its application has been widened to new dimension that distinguishes unique identity from other institutions. Tourism and Recreational Planning in hilly region like Chittagong, the commercial capital of Bangladesh will contribute a lot to national economy.
